raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 delivered 27 txn_ids twice: a record_version 1 row and a corrected record_version 2 row, differing only in amount. silver_transactions keeps both copies, which duplicates keys and double-counts amounts in every gold table. The fix assumes the highest record_version supersedes earlier ones; no change note confirms this, though the column's design implies it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.74, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
